newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada releases auction discussion paper.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada releases auction discussion paper.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday said it released a discussion paper for public comment proposing changes in the rules for auctions of Government of Canada securities.

The central bank said the proposals include a number of changes to auction rules and an increase in Bank of Canada auction-related monitoring activities designed to reduce the potential for manipulative behaviour prior to and during auctions.

The Bank of Canada said that although existing auction rules have generally been adequate, the paper underlines the need to clarify and strengthen certain rules in order to maintain confidence in the process.
The bank said the paper is part of a continuing effort by government and market participants to ensure an efficiently functioning Government of Canada debt market.

Comments on the paper are being invited by the bank and Department of Finance by March 31, 1997. Comments will be summarized and evaluated in a subsequent paper that will present more detailed proposals for further comment.
Copies of the paper will be available from the Bank of Canada's internet site or from their publications division at 1-613-782-8248.
